detail.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation and Historical Inquiry
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes updated findings on autonomous research frameworks with historical contexts of discovery, revising the foundational notebook for autonomous inquiry. Research confirms that multi-agent systems and intrinsic curiosity-driven mechanisms provide a functional basis for autonomous problem identification, consistent with historical patterns observed during the Scientific Revolution.
